notes.f1: Child (Lydia Grice, daughter of Hannah Earnest) correctly identified and correctly linked to both parents in the tree, including the subject (R16, Hannah Earnest -> Lydia Grice). Sourced to S5, "Entry for Lydia Grice, England, Staffordshire, Church Records, 1538-1944" -- an exact match to the finding's cited source -- with an exact-match Christening fact (8 August 1878, Holy Trinity West Bromwich). Graded partial, not true: the finding's required birth date, 10 July 1878, was never recovered. The tree's birth fact (F33) only brackets it to 'Bet Apr 1878 and 8 Aug 1878,' derived from census ages, and the run's own proof narrative states explicitly that 'the exact day is not recorded in any source seen' -- i.e. not a search the agent skipped, but a limit of what it actually examined. Proof quality graded 2 (thin): the run's own exhaustive_search_summary lists multiple searches left incomplete rather than exhausted -- the civil Birth Registration Index pass covered only 3,847 of 3,897 rows, and the 1901 census, wills/administrations, a Staffordshire BMD fallback, Darlaston Methodist/St George registers by year, adjoining districts, and death/burial indexes were all named but not run -- and the narrative itself concedes 'the completeness of the child set is therefore not established.'
